claim: The existing OperatorOverlayService source is now composed with the existing persisted heartbeat projection, scene/view-model, refresh dedupe plan, and native child controls. This is source wiring only.

code_first_scars.finding: The first native-source pass gave the horizontal scroller its own accessibility description, risking a competing TalkBack destination around independently focusable light buttons.
code_first_scars.repair: The scroller is now IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO; each native light owns its own semantics.

code_first_scars.finding: Explicit heartbeat detail announcements initially bypassed the global speech mute while automatic announcements honored it.
code_first_scars.repair: Explicit detail announcement now checks OperatorState.muted before speaking.

code_first_scars.finding: Future model touch targets could increase beyond the existing button default while the first pass only reasserted minimum height.
code_first_scars.repair: Heartbeat controls now honor the model/overlay minimum on both width and height.

test_evidence.exact_annotation: The job was not started because an Actions budget is preventing further use.
